results.content:
Title: KDR Realty LLC | BBB Complaints | Better Business Bureau
## Cookies on BBB.org. We use cookies to give users the best content and online experience. By clicking “Accept All Cookies”, you agree to allow us to use all cookies. This business is **NOT BBB Accredited.**. The complaint text that is displayed might not represent all complaints filed with BBB. Some consumers may elect to not publish the details of their complaints, some complaints may not meet BBB's standards for publication, or BBB may display a portion of complaints when a high volume is received for a particular business. We would be happy to discuss this matter with you and come to a resolution. We want to start off by thanking you for staying with us at Continental North and we apologize that you are experiencing some things within your unit that can be frustrating. We ensure you that we are working on handling the issues, if not, already taken care of. The safety and concerns of all our residents is important to us. While the property has been condemned, this decision was made by the City of Gardner. We are actively working with the City of Gardner to address the concerns affecting the property and are committed to making the necessary repairs as quickly and efficiently as possible. in order for us to not live in uninhabitable living conditions before the place was condemned, there was no effort made by your company to let us out of our lease without having to pay anything. We would ask that you refund us our money, It’s not fair to the people who had to make the decision to move and pay boat loads of money because the company couldn’t figure out how to fix their units. We understand the frustration surrounding the current situation and want to assure you that we have been actively working to resolve the issue. Our lease was legally terminated under K.S.A. 58-2559 due to the landlord’s failure to address a long-standing habitability issue (repeated flooding of the basement) which made the property partially unsafe and uninhabitable for over six months. This is not a case of a broken lease - it is a lawful termination due to a serious breach of habitability, as defined by Kansas landlord-tenant law.

The most frustrating aspect is that I had previously recommended Kitchen Connection to my daughter following our positive experience in 2020.

She went with the North Lakes team at the same time as us and initially had a good experience. However, her project also encountered several installation and product issues, including damaged items and errors that required rectification.

Although those problems were eventually resolved, it took a considerable amount of time. She is still experiencing an issue with part of her benchtop lifting, but has decided to engage a cabinet maker privately rather than go through Kitchen Connection again. [...] When we contacted Kitchen Connection staff regarding wardrobe-related issues, we were repeatedly told they could not assist because it was a different company. This made obtaining information and resolving issues unnecessarily frustrating.

Communication overall was poor. Had we not exchanged phone numbers directly with the tradespeople, we would have received very little information throughout the project.
